from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialMetric(BaseModel):
    """A specific financial metric extracted from a single document."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name reported in the document")
    fiscal_year: str | None = Field(description="The fiscal year the data point corresponds to")
    metric_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact label used in the document for the metric (e.g., 'Operating Income', 'Operating (loss) income')")
    metric_value: float | None = Field(description="The numerical value of the metric; negative for losses")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The scale of the unit (e.g., 'millions', 'thousands', 'dollars')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_metrics: list[FinancialMetric]
